node.title: Pure dyadic quotient pullbacks are absent from the sharp FPC5 flat
node.statement: At the official rate-half sharp FPC5 endpoint, n=2^41 and the locator degree j=2ell-3 is odd. Every proper multiplicative quotient scale M>1 dividing n is even, while a pure pullback g(X^M), equivalently a root set that is a union of complete mu_M-orbits, has degree divisible by M. Hence the pure multiplicative periodic stratum is empty. Incomplete-orbit tails, rational pullbacks, and reciprocal/dihedral symmetry are not excluded.
